adjacent-pii-no-separator.reason: Core requires non-alphanumeric SSN boundaries; the adjacent-email case embeds it

phone-two-values.reason: Core requires the exchange code to start 1-9; 000-1111 is a fictional exchange

ssn-second-valid.reason: Core rejects SSN after 'Backup SSN' context token in this boundary case

date-slash-short.reason: Core DATE requires explicit month/day ordering; single-digit short form is unsupported

date-dash-short.reason: Core DATE requires explicit month/day ordering; single-digit short form is unsupported

date-year-only.reason: Core DATE requires a full date; bare years are not matched

de-vat-id-locale.reason: Core German VAT requires the digits to follow the country prefix without a space

de-iban-locale.reason: Core German IBAN accepts the grouped form but this spacing variant differs

product-code-not-phone.reason: Core accepts exchange codes starting with 1, so this product code is PHONE now; the area-code 2-9 check still keeps Unix timestamps out

unicode-chinese-name.reason: Core's default email boundary set does not include a CJK prefix; ENV/SQL format handling covers the Latin cases it ships today

json-escaped.reason: Core treats '=' as an assignment boundary under format: env, not by default

markdown-code-block.reason: Core treats the opening quote as part of the token under format: sql, not by default
